+package redis
+
+import (

+	"crypto/x509"

+

+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache connection configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS} //nolint:gosec // explicitly requested by configuration
+		var cert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+		if len(cert) > 0 {
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,

+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil

+package redis

+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	certificate := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}))
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(certificate), 0600))
+
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name        string
+		cfg         config.RedisCacheConfig
+		customRoots bool
+		skipVerify  bool
+	}{
+		{name: "system roots", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true}},
+		{name: "inline CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: certificate}, customRoots: true},
+		{name: "CA path", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: path}, customRoots: true},
+		{name: "insecure", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}, skipVerify: true},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			tlsConfig := client.Options().TLSConfig
+			require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig)
+			require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), tlsConfig.MinVersion)
+			require.Equal(t, tc.skipVerify, tlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if tc.customRoots {
+				require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+				require.NotEmpty(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs.Subjects())
+			} else {
+				require.Nil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewClientInvalidCA(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.RedisCacheConfig
+		want string
+	}{
+		{name: "both", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{CaCertPath: "ca.pem", CaCertBytes: "cert"}, want: "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{name: "missing file", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.pem")}, want: "reading redis CA certificate"},
+		{name: "invalid PEM", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"}, want: "invalid redis CA certificate"},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.Nil(t, client)
+			require.ErrorContains(t, err, tc.want)
+		})
+	}

+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache connection configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS} //nolint:gosec // explicitly requested by configuration
+		var cert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+		if len(cert) > 0 {
+			roots := x509.NewCertPool()
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}

+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	certificate := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}))
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(certificate), 0600))
+
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name        string
+		cfg         config.RedisCacheConfig
+		customRoots bool
+		skipVerify  bool
+	}{
+		{name: "system roots", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true}},
+		{name: "inline CA", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: certificate}, customRoots: true},
+		{name: "CA path", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: path}, customRoots: true},
+		{name: "insecure", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true}, skipVerify: true},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tc.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			tlsConfig := client.Options().TLSConfig
+			require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig)
+			require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), tlsConfig.MinVersion)
+			require.Equal(t, tc.skipVerify, tlsConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			if tc.customRoots {
+				require.NotNil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+				require.NotEmpty(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs.Subjects())
+			} else {
+				require.Nil(t, tlsConfig.RootCAs)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}

+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.RedisCacheConfig
+		want string
+	}{
+		{name: "both", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{CaCertPath: "ca.pem", CaCertBytes: "cert"}, want: "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path"},
+		{name: "missing file", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertPath: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "missing.pem")}, want: "reading redis CA certificate"},
+		{name: "invalid PEM", cfg: config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"}, want: "invalid redis CA certificate"},
